what: When the panel is 25% visible, the children (items) drop in turn from above the panel (spacing of .6 of the height), bounce (restitution .35 · friction .25 · air .012) on the floor and shelf, roll and pile up. They can be picked up and thrown with the mouse (stiffness .2). Round ones (data-shape=circle) is a circle, the rest are boxes with rounded corners — a scene where rolls of colored tape pour down and pile up over the footer wordmark

options.gap: Height gap at which falling starts (share of child height), default 1.2
options.at: Drop the panel once this much of it is visible, default .25

note: matter-js 0.20.0 (library/_vendor/matter-js@0.20.0). Wheel listening is removed so the page scrolls even over the board. On touch devices (hover false) grab is not attached, so touches are not intercepted. With reduced motion, 600 frames are pre-run and only the settled pile is shown. Children are moved into the board as absolute and drawn with transform. The site drew to a canvas, but parts are drawn as DOM so they accept any element

from.where: All pages .st-footer__phys — with the original Matter.Engine·Runner, six tape rolls fall and pile up on STICK BY YOU and can be grabbed with the mouse (the copy’s shared.js draws the roll images on a canvas)

shared.js G.reviews (.g-reviews__scene — 8 circles in the reviews section) — original HomeReviews (matter-js 0.20.0): when the section’s top edge reaches the center of the screen, the circles drop from (diameter/2 + index×70px) above, gravity 2.8 · restitution .08 · friction .85 · static friction .9 · air .035 · density .01. With this part’s options "gravity: 2.8; bounce: .08; shape: circle; at: .5". Original only — the circle under the hand bounces sideways and up (mass×.02 · .025, 700ms rest) and paging testimonials bounces within 380px around that circle (in the site’s shared.js), no pick-up-and-throw
Footer .hl-socials — four round SNS buttons (shape: circle · bounce .4). The original threw them in at random up to 1.5x height above with matter-js
